description: Matches the default map centre (33.6844, 73.0479). Draw a RESTRICTED zone around 33.6849, 73.0485 and a site zone around the centre to see entry, breach, SOS, a gas leak (VEST-001, 2,800 ppm for 20 s from its third waypoint) and offline detection. Register vests VEST-001 and VEST-002 and assign them to workers first.
